prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production-ready symbol for AIRO / 아이로, a premium AI travel companion website. Create ONE standalone logo symbol, not a presentation board.
Primary request: Design an original, striking, beautifully proportioned abstract A monogram that feels confident, dynamic and sophisticated. Combine the silhouette of an uppercase A with a single ascending travel trajectory. Construct it from two substantial geometric ribbon-like strokes and one precise negative-space cut. Give the silhouette a subtle forward lean and a memorable asymmetric notch; evoke a route unfolding into a destination through shape alone. It should feel like a serious, crafted identity, not an illustration or a generic AI badge.
Style: impeccably clean, flat, vector-like geometry, sharp intentional cuts with just slightly softened outer corners, optical balance, bold enough to work at 24px. The folded-ribbon impression must come from silhouette and negative space, not shading. Restrained, contemporary editorial design.
Color: symbol entirely solid pale pistachio #D5E6B4. This symbol will appear on the existing near-black #0A0A0A website. All negative space and the full canvas background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including inside the monogram.
Composition: square canvas, one large centered symbol taking approximately 84% of the canvas width and height, evenly balanced transparent margins. No rounded-square container or background tile.
Text: none. No wordmark, letters outside the single abstract A symbol, captions, sample sizes or explanations.
Avoid: sparkles, four-point stars, location-pin outlines, hearts, globe illustrations, airplane clipart, thin line art, gradients, metallic surfaces, shadows, lighting effects, 3D renders, mockups, multiple variants, watermarks. Do not imitate another company's logo.
Return a clean transparent PNG logo asset.
integration: The generated PNG alpha is used as a CSS mask to retain the actual generated silhouette while matching both existing themes; no manually redrawn SVG mark.
exportNotes: Original PNG is unchanged. WebP and icon assets are faithful size/format exports. Existing logo files were backed up under assets/brand/previous. The previous public SVG URL now contains a raster-backed compatibility export of the generated mark.
